text: Without rules, one wrong update could switch on a shop nobody ever checked.
prefix: Without rules, one wrong update could switch on a shop nobody ever checked.

text: So a partner moves through fixed states: pending, verified, waiting for a contract, approved, and active.
prefix: So a partner moves through fixed states: pending, verified, waiting for a contract, approved, and active.

text: The allowed moves live in one table inside the status enum, and every other move is refused.

text: An illegal jump, like pending straight to active, answers four oh nine with a stable error code.

text: An admin verifies the documents, but only after the merchant has verified its email.

text: Signing the contract approves the partner, and the database keeps every contract number unique.

text: Every change writes a row to the status history: from where, to where, who, and why.
prefix: Every change writes a row to the status history: from where, to where, who, and why.

text: Each row is saved in the same transaction as the change, and is never updated.

text: An active merchant can be suspended and restored, or terminated for good.
